(Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’) · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’fight!’ (μάχεσθαι ἐνὶ πρώτοισι) · also pres. inf. in an indirect alternative question: ’whether to fight’ (ἢ φευγέμεν ἠὲ μάχεσθαι ’whether to flee or to fight’)

__broaden__.τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’)

__broaden__.ὄφελεν: ὀφείλω (ὀφέλλω) — owe, ought; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤφελε(ν)); with ὡς + inf., an unfulfilled wish: ’would that’ · also aor. 3 sg. + inf. without ὡς, an unfulfilled obligation: ’ought to’ (ὄφελεν … πονέεσθαι ’ought to be toiling’)
